name: hdie_pc_ctrl_cfg

job.purpose: H7 = H6 geometry (185.76x164.16, full-M5 SRAM reservation, west corridor) + QREG=1 RTL. H6 route 0c263832f: DRC0/GRT0 but TT -50.14 ps, 888 D pins, all in four unchanged-cycle classes: skid head -> K legality/same-row -> accepted -> 2,048 queue-flop enables (296 paths, -41.3); ep -> queue[ep] 32:1 -> bank decode -> controller wq_boh/wq_older/wq_col (247, -46.6); blk -> bank eligibility -> 32-wide slot reduction -> age winner -> wab_oh/wab (36, -50.1); owner_fault -> identity address -> head_identity (16, -28.1). Fix: queue written at free slots (no accepted in the enable), push entry a maintained register, identity candidates read from registered addresses, controller PHYS_WACT 2 registers bank/slot write-ACT eligibility from exact next-state values. +0 cycles; lockstep miters vs H6 (leaf QREG 0/1 every output every edge; controller PHYS_WACT 0/1/2) PASS with 4+3 mutants rejected.

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers its boundary itself (OREG: every PHY command output from a flop; KREG: K request in a 2-entry pin skid, k_rdy from a register; KRREG: K response from a 2-entry skid; RREG: PHY return valid+data captured at the pin; pc_id/refresh_reload straps captured in pc_id_q/refresh_reload_q). Flow pin registers would add a cycle inside the elastic K ready/valid handshake (HBM-stack boundary, owner 10-14) and overflow the skids.
